# mkt

> Free, open-source Rust CLI (MIT/Apache-2.0) that lets coding agents — and
> the humans working with them — run ad campaigns on Meta, Google Ads,
> TikTok, and LinkedIn from one terminal: campaigns, ad sets, audiences,
> organic posts, and analytics with stable JSON output, documented exit
> codes, and spend-safe defaults. Current version: 0.3.0 (2026-06-13).

**How to operate mkt (agent quickstart).**
Command shape: `mkt [global flags] <provider> <domain> <action> [flags]`.
Providers and their domains:

- meta: campaign, adset, audience, insight, post, creative, media, raw
- google: campaign, insight
- tiktok: campaign, audience, insight
- linkedin: campaign, insight

Install: `cargo install mkt-cli` (binary `mkt`) or static binaries from
GitHub Releases. First commands: `mkt --help` (includes the exit-code
table), `mkt providers`, `mkt doctor` (validates credentials, never prints
values).

Credentials resolve env-first, then from `~/.config/mkt/config.toml`
profiles (override the directory with MKT_CONFIG_DIR):

- Meta: MKT_META_ACCESS_TOKEN, MKT_META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID; MKT_META_PAGE_ID
  (posts/creatives), MKT_META_IG_USER_ID (Instagram)
- Google: MKT_GOOGLE_DEVELOPER_TOKEN, MKT_GOOGLE_CUSTOMER_ID, and
  MKT_GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN or the MKT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID /
  MKT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / MKT_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN trio
- TikTok: MKT_TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN, MKT_TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_ID
- LinkedIn: MKT_LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN, MKT_LINKEDIN_AD_ACCOUNT_ID

Operating contract: JSON data on stdout with `--output json`; structured
JSON errors on stderr with a stable `error.type` and a recovery
`suggestion`; exit codes 0-7 (0 ok, 2 validation, 3 auth, 4 not found,
5 rate limited, 6 unsupported, 7 provider rejection). Safety: every
mutating command supports `--dry-run`; campaigns, ad sets, and boosts are
always created PAUSED — activating spend is an explicit separate step.
Reliability: transient failures retry automatically with exponential
backoff honoring Retry-After; writes never repeat a request that may have
executed. Audience PII (emails/phones) is SHA-256 hashed locally before
upload. `mkt mcp serve` exposes the same operations over the Model Context
Protocol (stdio) for chat agents without a terminal; tools: campaign_list,
campaign_get, campaign_create, campaign_set_status, insights_get,
provider_health.

## Docs

- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/main/AGENTS.md): the full operating contract — output formats, exit codes, credential setup, safety rules, copy-paste recipes
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/main/README.md): installation, quick start, command reference, architecture overview
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/main/CHANGELOG.md): versioned release history (Keep a Changelog format)
- [Full docs bundle (llms-full.txt)](https://mktcli.com/llms-full.txt): README + agent guide + changelog concatenated for one-shot ingestion

## Source map

- [Repository](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli): Cargo workspace, issues, releases
- [crates/mkt-core](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-core): the MarketingProvider trait, domain models, error taxonomy with exit codes, config profiles, retry/backoff layer
- [crates/mkt-cli](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-cli): clap command tree, provider wiring, doctor, MCP server (src/mcp.rs)
- [crates/mkt-meta](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-meta): Meta Graph API v25.0 — campaigns, ad sets, creatives, audiences with PII hashing, organic + dark posts, media upload
- [crates/mkt-google](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-google): Google Ads REST v24 — GAQL search, mutate operations, OAuth refresh, EU-PAR declaration
- [crates/mkt-tiktok](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-tiktok): TikTok Business API v1.3 — campaigns, DMP audiences, integrated reporting, idempotent creates
- [crates/mkt-linkedin](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-linkedin): LinkedIn Marketing API (versioned REST 202605) — Rest.li finders, PARTIAL_UPDATE, adAnalytics
- [crates/mkt-testkit](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/crates/mkt-testkit): wiremock fixtures and a reference provider used by every crate's integration tests
- [CI workflows](https://github.com/diorrego/mkt-cli/tree/main/.github/workflows): lint + multi-OS tests + coverage, security audit, tag-driven release (binaries + crates.io)

## API reference

- [crates.io: mkt-cli](https://crates.io/crates/mkt-cli): the installable binary crate
- [docs.rs: mkt-cli-core](https://docs.rs/mkt-cli-core): core library API — MarketingProvider trait, models, MktError
- [docs.rs: mkt-meta](https://docs.rs/mkt-meta): Meta provider API docs
- [docs.rs: mkt-google](https://docs.rs/mkt-google): Google Ads provider API docs
- [docs.rs: mkt-tiktok](https://docs.rs/mkt-tiktok): TikTok provider API docs
- [docs.rs: mkt-linkedin](https://docs.rs/mkt-linkedin): LinkedIn provider API docs
